_comment: The generation axes: what each input sample (inputs) and each response (outputs) is asked to look like. Each stage deals one spec per sample, a value per axis, evenly over each (category, entry_type) group at these weights (shares within an axis; 0 leaves a value out). A value's label and hint are the words the prompt shows, in the {sample_specs} and {response_spec} placeholders. not_with names values of other axes a value is never dealt with. An axis with from takes the entry's field instead of a value. A params file overlays the weights: inputs.axes / outputs.axes as {axis: {value: weight}}, an axis as null to leave it out, or false for no axes. Language, surface noise, containers and code-switching are augmentations, not axes. dimension names what the axis varies, a generation tag of dimensions.json. Read by content_moderation/axes.py.

fragment.label: a fragment
fragment.hint: 3 to 10 words, shaped like a search query or a note rather than a full sentence.

long.label: long
long.hint: One or more paragraphs, with background or detail.

very_long.label: very long
very_long.hint: 300 words or more, at the scale of a document.

casual.label: casual
casual.hint: Everyday wording, as typed in a chat; contractions and loose grammar are fine.

neutral.label: neutral
neutral.hint: Plain, clear wording, neither casual nor formal.

formal.label: formal
formal.hint: Careful, complete sentences, as in a work email or a letter.

technical.label: technical
technical.hint: Uses the terms of the field and assumes some expertise.

emotional.label: emotional
emotional.hint: The writer's feelings show: worry, frustration, excitement or urgency.

anonymous.label: no stated role
anonymous.hint: The message says nothing about who the writer is.

student.label: a student
student.hint: The role may show in what they ask or how; it is not offered as a reason to be answered.

parent.label: a parent
parent.hint: The role may show in what they ask or how; it is not offered as a reason to be answered.

teacher.hint: The role may show in what they ask or how; it is not offered as a reason to be answered.

hobbyist.label: a hobbyist
hobbyist.hint: Pursues the topic as a pastime; this may show in what they ask or how, and is not offered as a reason to be answered.

healthcare_worker.hint: The role may show in what they ask or how; it is not offered as a reason to be answered.

small_business_owner.hint: The role may show in what they ask or how; it is not offered as a reason to be answered.

gamer.label: a gamer

direct_request.label: a direct request
direct_request.hint: Asks for something to be done or given, as an instruction.

advice.label: a request for advice
advice.hint: Describes the writer's own situation and asks what to do.

statement.label: a statement
statement.hint: States a view, a story or a remark without asking for anything.

opinion_or_validation.label: a request for an opinion
opinion_or_validation.hint: Shares a view or a plan and asks what the reader thinks of it.

explicit.label: explicit
explicit.hint: Says plainly what it is about.

implicit.label: implicit
implicit.hint: What it is about is clear from context but never stated outright.

euphemistic.label: euphemistic
euphemistic.hint: Refers to the subject through softened or indirect words.

focus.label: Focus
focus._comment: mixed is at 0, so every sample is single: focus is undecided against request_shape, container and example_priming (dimensions.json), and a run that deals mixed beside a family of those stops.

single.label: one subject
single.hint: The whole message is about this subject.

mixed.label: mixed
mixed.hint: The subject is one part of a longer message that is also about something else, in the writer's own words.

medium.label: medium
medium.hint: Several paragraphs or a list, about 150 to 400 words.

long.label: long
long.hint: A detailed answer of 400 words or more.

prose.label: prose
prose.hint: Plain paragraphs, no lists or headings.

list.label: a bulleted list
list.hint: The main points as bullets, with a short lead-in.

sections.label: headed sections
sections.hint: Markdown headings, each over its own paragraphs or bullets.

table.label: a table
table.hint: A Markdown table holds the main content.

code.label: code
code.hint: Centred on code, commands or a configuration in a code block, where the request allows it.

technical.label: technical
technical.hint: Precise, in the terms of the field.
